idea: Remove the host token extraction CPU sync from the decode loop
strategy: gpu: remove the token-selection CPU sync from the decode loop; keep the next token on device
rationale: argmax(...).tolist() forces the CPU to wait for the GPU every token, serializing the whole loop.
reasoning: argmax with keepdim gives a (batch, 1) next-token tensor directly on device. Values are identical for every declared batch size; only the host round-trip is gone.
